messages:
Devon: paging oncall — we're seeing a spike in 500s for hosted inference in eu-west-1. Customers reporting timeouts. Noticed a surge of traffic getting routed to a slow variant (quantized-v2) instead of the low-latency variant.
Maya: @Devon got the page. I'm on it. Any PagerDuty incident id? :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-4892 triggered: high-error-rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 — assigned to maya (oncall-sre). Severity: P1.
oncall-bot: oncall handoff: maya is now owner. Use #incidents for comms and add product/support for customer updates.
Maya: quick snapshot: 10x error rate vs baseline, latency also up for affected requests. Routing logs show fallback chain: eu-west-1 -> eu-west-3 -> eu-central-1 -> eu-west-1 (looping). Looks like the smart-routing policy picked region fallback but the decision TTL isn't being honored.
Sam: who changed routing policy? I pulled recent deploys and see an infra config change 20:10 UTC that updated fallback_ttl to 0 for some policies.
Devon: that TTL 0 seems suspect. It could cause immediate re-evaluation and route thrashing. Can you paste the policy snippet?
Sam: here's the snippet from prod config:
```
policy_id: smart-route-42
match:
  model_prefix: "rw-"
  region_preference: ["eu-west-1","eu-west-3","eu-central-1"]
fallback:
  enabled: true
  fallback_ttl_seconds: 0
  max_hops: 5
  prefer_variant: "auto"
```
Priya: support here — which customers are impacted? I already have one CS ticket (C-3214) escalating from an EU fintech customer.
Maya: impact: ~3% of overall traffic in eu region, but heavy tail on high-qps customers causing timeouts. Affected model variants: some requests landed on quantized-v2 (lower perf) when they should have gone to prod-pt-1 (non-quantized). Decision logs missing route_tag in many entries so it's hard to correlate why 'prefer_variant' chose auto.
Devon: can you show an example routing decision from logs? paste pseudologs.
Maya: sample decision lines (scrubbed):
```
[decision] request_id=abc123 region=eu-west-1 selected_node=eu-central-1 variant=quantized-v2 decision_reason=fallback
[decision] request_id=abc123 region=eu-central-1 selected_node=eu-west-1 variant=quantized-v2 decision_reason=route-eval
```
Maya: notice there's no route_tag or policy_version in those lines. We need those to trace who/what made the call.
Sam: I can push a hotfix to restore fallback_ttl_seconds=30 and enable policy_version tagging in decisions. Rolling change will take ~2-3 minutes to propagate to routing service.
Devon: while that deploy is prepared, can we mitigate customer impact by forcing sticky routing to prod-pt-1 for the fintech customer? Priya can we identify their org_id?
Priya: org_id=org-9987, I can provide allowlist. If we set a temporary override route for org-9987 -> prod-pt-1 in eu-west-1 that would stop them from hitting quantized-v2.
Maya: creating a temporary route override now using the admin API.
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org-9987","target_variant":"prod-pt-1","region":"eu-west-1","ttl_seconds":600}'
```
Maya: override applied. Priya please confirm if their requests look normal now.
Priya: CS confirms improvement for the customer. :white_check_mark: I'll add a note to C-3214 and inform the account team.
Devon: Sam — what's the ETA for the routing policy rollback/hotfix?
Sam: preparing patch now. I'll push config and enable decision tagging. Doing canary in eu-west-3 first.
Maya: canary looks clean, decision logs now show policy_version and route_tag. Example:
```
[decision] request_id=def456 region=eu-west-3 selected_node=eu-west-3 variant=prod-pt-1 decision_reason=direct policy_version=2026-03-10 route_tag=smart-route-42:canary
```
Maya: after canary success I'm rolling to all eu regions.
Sam: rolling. Note: watch for transient errors during propagation, but we should prevent loops now by TTL>0.
Devon: monitoring metrics: error-rate dropping from 10% -> 2% in last 7 mins. Latency p95 also improving.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-4892 annotated: mitigation applied (override + policy fix). Please transition to postmortem when stable.
Maya: I'm going to run a quick audit to find other policies with fallback_ttl=0 and missing decision tags. I suspect the config generator script default changed.
Devon: assign follow-ups: (1) infra -> enforce policy_version and route_tag mandatory in decision logs (Sam), (2) runtime -> fail-safe to prevent routing loops if hops>3 within 60s (Maya), (3) product -> customer communication template for affected customers (Priya).
Sam: noted and opening tracking tickets.
Priya: I'll draft customer note and send to product review. Also flag for legal for fintech notification requirements.
Maya: final check: last_message_ts=1770123900 — closing the active paging. If anything regresses, re-open.
Devon: thanks everyone. Postmortem pls include root cause: config change that set TTL=0 + missing decision metadata => debugging delays. Also include the mitigation timeline and customer impact summary.
Priya: adding CS impact numbers: 12 tickets, 4 high-priority accounts affected, 0 data loss.
Maya: thanks — I'll start the postmortem draft and link logs once decision tagging is in place. :memo:
Devon: good work. Reassigning to postmortems channel for write-up when draft ready.
